players.product: trapped-ion quantum computers (Forte, Forte Enterprise) sold as systems and as cloud access, plus quantum networking, sensing and security products

quarterly_data.signal: IonQ (10-K): revenue is concentrated - three significant customers (each more than 10% of revenue) accounted for 53% of 2025 revenue (two accounted for 77% in 2024); its customers, potential customers and partners include government agencies such as the U.S. Air Force Research Lab, DARPA and Oak Ridge National Laboratory.
quarterly_data.figure: three significant customers = 53% of 2025 revenue (two = 77% in 2024)

quarterly_data.signal: IonQ (10-K): has announced co-development agreements for quantum applications with Ansys (computer-aided design and engineering), the Centre for Commercialization of Regenerative Medicine (advanced therapeutics optimization) and DARPA (benchmarking of quantum computers).

Licensor Duke University: in July 2016 IonQ entered an exclusive license agreement and an exclusive option agreement with Duke, licensing certain intellectual property and, under the option agreement amendments, purchasing research and development services.
